req.title: Partial update supported
req.statement: The system shall accept a partial payload on PUT /tasks/{task_id} and leave omitted fields unchanged.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-012 requires that PUT /tasks/{task_id} accepts partial payloads and leaves omitted fields unchanged. The test suite covers: (1) positive EP — sending only one field and verifying others are preserved; (2) positive STC — updating completed flag from false→true while title/description unchanged; (3) negative NEG — sending an invalid title (empty string, violating min_length=1) and expecting 422; (4) boundary BVA — sending title at exactly max_length=100 chars (boundary-valid) and description at exactly 500 chars; (5) negative NEG — sending description exceeding 500 chars (501 chars) expecting 422; (6) DT — sending all three optional fields simultaneously; (7) EP — partial update on non-existent task_id expecting 404. Each test uses an in-process TestClient with a fresh SQLite DB, seeds exactly the pre-loaded rows needed, and asserts exact values to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_partial_update_only_title_leaves_other_fields_unchanged
preconditions: Task with id=7 exists: title='Fix login bug', description='Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.', completed=false
actions: PUT /tasks/7 with payload {"title": "Fixed login bug"} (omitting description and completed)
expected: Response description == 'Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.' (unchanged)
tests.executable:
import os, tempfile
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app.database import get_db
from app import models

tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
db_path = os.path.join(tmp, 'test.db')
engine = create_engine(f'sqlite:///{db_path}', connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
TestingSession = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)

with TestingSession() as s:
    s.add(models.Task(id=7, title='Fix login bug', description='Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.', completed=False))
    s.commit()

def override_get_db():
    db = TestingSession()
    try:
        yield db
    finally:
        db.close()

app.dependency_overrides[get_db] = override_get_db
client = TestClient(app)

def test_partial_update_only_title_leaves_other_fields_unchanged():
    r = client.put('/tasks/7', json={'title': 'Fixed login bug'})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    body = r.json()
    assert body['id'] == 7
    assert body['title'] == 'Fixed login bug'
    assert body['description'] == 'Ember willow nova meridian flux cascade zenith.'
    assert body['completed'] == False

test_partial_update_only_title_leaves_other_fields_unchanged()
app.dependency_overrides.clear()
